name: Existing V10 3D and hourly energy remain functional
description: Retains original Three.js site, hourly weather and interactive source flow as the V11 platform foundation.
steps: Open 3D Experience and choose SOLAR PV camera
Move the hourly slider to 12:00 and observe solar available and generator status
Move the slider to midnight and confirm diesel supplies load
Open Economics and move delivered diesel price
expected: 3D assets and source routes remain visible; PV is zero at midnight and financial cards update.

name: V11 scenario compare and diesel savings
description: Compare independently modeled 304 and 456 kWp microgrids with clear fuel and energy provenance.
steps: Check the annual generator-off and curtailed PV output
Inspect 24-hour dispatch chart and emissions cards
expected: Supplier scenario displays independent model outputs, and its unpriced EPC cash-flow is not shown as a validated value.

name: Missing CAPEX guardrail
description: Prevents fictitious supplier economics and allows explicit provisional cost entry.
steps: Verify NPV and IRR are pending without a supplier CAPEX
Enter an illustrative EPC quote in USD
Verify results become available and are labelled screening
expected: Unknown CAPEX is never silently inherited from the 304 kWp base case; results appear only after explicit entry.

name: Power circuit linking and reporting
description: Validates live engineering schematic selection and self-contained investment export.
steps: Click the BESS node in the interactive SLD
Check the 3D scene targets the battery inspector
expected: BESS asset becomes selected and an Excel-compatible cash-flow CSV downloads; printable executive summary is available.
